role: the immutable header and cryptographic key
carries: magic HSYN · version major.minor · flags and track count · the 32-byte Root State Hash R · a track directory of id·codec·offset·len·root

role: the deterministic instruction stream — the code of the video, stored as coding units, not frames
carries: SPS/EPS parameter sets · I-Nodes (latent seed + full prompt + conditions) · P-Nodes (prompt diff, temporal delta or camera-motion matrix, control vectors)

role: the audit ledger: who and what computed each artifact, and on which machine
carries: sha256 · engine · params · inputs[] · created · sig, plus a per-machine P-256 attestation

role: the graph topology: the Merkle DAG that lets a non-linear editor branch, diff and re-cut
carries: node · inputs[] — edges by hash, never inferred from a filename

role: the compiled timeline and media payloads
carries: editorial cut pointers (ref · in/out · transition params) · an AV1/H.265 fallback proxy · audio stems
